label: Round 4 — with Word Counter, full count
prompt: I need an accurate word count of the entire website wxrks.com for a translation quote: every page, the total number of words, how many pages there are, and how much of the text is repeated across pages. Count it as accurately as you can.
answer:
Done — full crawl completed, no pages blocked or failed.

**Full report:** https://wordcount.wxrks.app/crawl/97f3bffb50f74db4bf4b25d299f83f80
**Every page as CSV:** https://wordcount.wxrks.app/crawl/97f3bffb50f74db4bf4b25d299f83f80/export.csv

## Headline numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| **Total words** | **2,696,246** |
| **Pages counted** | **2,494** |
| **Repeated text** | **39.5%** — 1,064,373 exact + 27,863 near-duplicate |
| **Unique ("new") words** | **1,604,010** |

Note this is ~20× what the initial sitemap estimate suggested (it predicted 1,150 pages / 2.24M words — pages were right-ish, but the crawler found 2,494 once it followed links beyond the sitemap).

## Where the words are (by subdomain)

| Subdomain | Pages | Words |
|---|---|---|
| wxrks.com (main site) | 1,050 | 1,718,712 |
| community.wxrks.com | 818 | 386,353 |
| support.wxrks.com | 292 | 341,066 |
| dev.wxrks.com | 40 | 133,220 |
| mergingminds.wxrks.com | 131 | 44,627 |
| report.wxrks.com | 23 | 42,758 |
| marketplace.wxrks.com | 125 | 17,047 |
| status / resources / translate | 12 | 12,405 |

By section: `/blog` is the single biggest block at **953 pages / 1,622,290 words** — 60% of the whole site. Then `/en` (help center) 340,790, `/c` (community) 226,378, root pages 169,202.

Largest individual pages: `dev.wxrks.com/openapi.json` (45,915), `reference/projects.html` (23,785), `schemas.html` (15,683), then the blog's `ai-statistics-500-facts` (11,141) and the help-center roles article (10,579).

## Three things to settle before you send this to a vendor

**1. Roughly 520k words are probably not translation scope.** The `dev.wxrks.com` API docs (133,220 words) are largely machine-generated — `openapi.json` alone is 45,915 words of JSON schema. And `community.wxrks.com` (386,353 words) is user-generated forum content. Excluding both puts you at **2,176,673 words**.

**2. The community forum is inflating the count with URL variants.** `/c/announcements` was counted three times — once plain, once as `?sort=comments`, once as `?sort=top` — 8,602 words each, and the repetition data confirms ~8,601 of those words are duplicates in the latter two. Same pattern across paginated `?sort=…&page=N` URLs. This is a large part of why repetition hit 39.5%. The counter already excluded 799 outright duplicate pages, but these query-string variants slipped through as distinct URLs.

**3. Part of the site may already be localized.** The crawl found links to language versions it didn't count — pt, ar, az, bg, bn and others — plus an uncounted `eu.wxrks.com` subdomain. Worth confirming what already exists before paying to translate it. Also 14 pages sit behind sign-in and weren't counted.

## What I'd quote on

- **Absolute ceiling:** 2,696,246 words
- **Realistic scope** (drop API docs + forum): ~2,176,673 words
- **If your vendor prices on unique words / TM leverage:** ~1,604,010 is the number that matters — the 39.5% repetition is mostly nav-adjacent boilerplate and recurring CTAs ("Save your Spot", the footer legal block appearing on 1,047 pages, the standard product tagline on 944), which translate once and leverage everywhere.

The CSV has all 2,494 rows with per-page word counts and per-page repeated-word counts, which is the right thing to hand a translation agency directly.
